title: Upfit Multiplier on Closed-End Early Termination — Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease
content:
# Pricing Note — Upfit Multiplier on the Early Termination Charge, Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease

**Rule.** For the early termination charge on a closed-end commercial unit of the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease ended before its scheduled end date by a turn-in or by a recovery after an uncured default, the termination upfit multiplier is 1.25 for a medium-duty chassis turned in fewer than 36 whole months after its in-service date, 1.10 for a unit of any other class whose upfit cost is more than 10 percent of its chassis cost and that was turned in fewer than 36 whole months after its in-service date, and 1 for every other unit.

**Records read.** The unit's vehicle class, its upfit cost and chassis cost, its in-service date and its turn-in date (the date it was turned in or recovered, as the unit records it). Whole months between two dates are counted from the earlier date to the later one and are one fewer where the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's.

## Condition table

| Vehicle class | Upfit cost against chassis cost | Whole months, in-service date to turn-in date | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|---|
| Medium-duty chassis | any | fewer than 36 | 1.25 |
| Medium-duty chassis | any | 36 or more | 1 |
| Any other class | more than 10 percent | fewer than 36 | 1.10 |
| Any other class | more than 10 percent | 36 or more | 1 |
| Any other class | 10 percent or less | any | 1 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical units)

- A cargo van with a chassis cost of 40000 and an upfit cost of 4000 has upfit of exactly 10 percent, which is not more than 10 percent: multiplier 1. With an upfit cost of 4001 and a turn-in 35 whole months after its in-service date: multiplier 1.10.
- The same cargo van, upfit 4001, turned in 36 whole months after its in-service date: multiplier 1.
- A medium-duty chassis turned in 35 whole months after its in-service date: multiplier 1.25, whatever its upfit; at 36 whole months: multiplier 1.
- Month counting: in service on the 20th of a month and turned in on the 19th of the month 36 months later is 35 whole months; turned in on the 20th of that month, it is 36.
